props.headline: Privacy policy
props.body:
This policy explains what data Alfred by E902 collects, why it is collected, and how you can control it. The short version: I read your connected business data to brief you, your data stays isolated to your organisation, nothing is used to train models across customers, and no raw data leaves your environment.

1. Data we process. Business data from the tools you explicitly connect, account details you provide, and standard usage data from this site.

2. How it is used. Connected data is used solely to deliver decision intelligence to your organisation: briefs, answers, flags, and actions you approve. It is never sold, shared with third parties, or used to train foundational models.

3. Your controls. You can disconnect any integration, export your data, or close your account at any time by contacting support@seekalfred.ai.
